author: Yuri Wong
description:
This is a story about a fun little chant, a late night in the studio, and what happened when I let a machine try to do my job.

I've been making music professionally for 20 years. This song I made for my 4 year old son is the most joy I've ever poured into a production.
It's the story of how our little cleanup chant became a big-band, New Orleans-style celebration song, what happened when I got AI to make its own version, and the existential crisis that followed.
Is it still worth making things in the age of AI? In this video, I found my answer. I hope it helps you find yours.

The song was made in Logic Pro. The AI version was made with Suno.
title: I Made a Song For My Son - Did AI Do It Better?
